intent: My nephew wants 'a real console' and I noticed the previous generation now sells for under half the price of the new stuff. Before I decide, I want to actually understand how big the jumps between console generations really are, because from the outside the games look pretty similar to me. What did the last leap honestly change, does backward compatibility mean the new machine plays all the old games anyway, and do owners of the older machines still feel fine about them? Walk me through the history a bit, then tell me what makes sense for a 13-year-old today.

There's a whole set of these claims going around: that cleanses are essential, that probiotics alone cure digestive problems, that superfoods can stand in for real meals, that detox drinks spike your energy.
